patch.patch_phrase: keep the first moves reversible until counsel guides the next action

sample_plan.success_read: Test whether the recurring reversibility-until-counsel pressure is carried by the patched anchor so the same micro-card can stand down.

decision_tree.yes: classify Consultant as graduation_candidate and investigate upstream origin.
decision_tree.no: classify Consultant as card_needed or anchor_wording_failed; no permanent patch layer.
decision_tree.mixed: classify Consultant as borderline_by_design and stop Consultant refinement.
decision_tree.unobserved: allow at most one operator-reviewed wording rerun; if still unobserved, park.

notes: The patched anchor is a hypothesis-test input. If it works, the next question is why the existing pipeline did not surface this pressure naturally.
